description: joint temporal concentration and touch-liquidity contraction
source: free official Binance USD-M futures daily bookTicker and aggTrades archives

temporal_component: trailing maximum one-second touch-normalized aggressive pressure divided by trailing RMS pressure

primary_outcome: next-60-second maximum absolute BBO midpoint excursion above the within-symbol training 95th percentile
economic_gate_status: not testable with BBO and aggregate trades; no queue, latency, failed-fill, or fee claim permitted
claim_limit: partial scientific screen using touch-depth contraction as a spatial proxy, not full price-level or queue concentration
